set.body:
Problem: DatasetMetadata and DatasetEvents are raw string maps. That keeps the core flexible, but it lets onset/duration/run/session/condition/covariate mistakes survive until later parser or fit stages.

Work: introduce typed dataset event and metadata rows, or a narrow adapter over the design table model, with smart constructors for onset, duration, run/session references, labels, covariates, and optional provenance. Keep lossy/string ingestion at IO boundaries.

Acceptance: FmriDataset can carry typed event rows aligned to its temporal/run axis; model-building adapters no longer rely on raw Map[String,String] at the core boundary; invalid event rows are represented by typed errors; existing tests are migrated or compatibility wrappers are explicit.
set.title: Dataset: replace string-map events and metadata with typed tables
